name: Machine Calf Press
steps: Adjust the calf press seat so your knees stay slightly bent with the balls of both feet on the platform.
Let your heels extend beyond the edge and grip the handles to keep your hips against the seat.
Push through the balls of your feet to press the platform forward into full ankle extension, squeezing your calves tightly.
Control the platform slowly back until your heels move past neutral into a full calf stretch.
tips: Keep your legs still so all movement comes strictly from flexing and extending your ankles.
Pause briefly at the fully stretched and contracted positions instead of bouncing the stack.
